text:
dina-ops: Heads up  internal lateral hire from Support->DevProd starts 2026-04-01. Manager requested compband regrade from L2 -> L3 and wants retro adjustment for April 1 start because offer letter was delayed. Payroll already processed April run. Can we route for an exception?

lucy-peopleops: What's the total base delta and did hiring manager sign off? We need manager confirmation and funding code. Also did candidate already accept via offer?

dina-ops: Base goes from $92,000 -> $115,000. Manager signed via DocuSign earlier today. Funding code: DP-5590 (receiving). Employee accepted 2026-03-20.

karthik-finance: For retro pay we'll need GL account and ledger movement. Also confirm if any bonus or sign-on payments previously paid that will need recalc.

dina-ops: No prior sign-on. Just normal comp. Manager requests off-cycle for April delta and benefits effective 4/1 retro.

benefits-team: FYI medical retro to 4/1 is borderline; we can process retro enrollment to the 1st of the month but need signed EO form and carrier approval. If the carrier denies, fallback is effective next month's 1st. Submit benefits-backdate-form with reason "internal transfer delayed offer".

ben-legal: Confirm that there's no equity/grant change; if there is, loop in comp-committee. Otherwise we can approve payroll-only change.

ryan-recruiting: Dina, please use the off-cycle template and include the manager attestation link. I'll help get manager to sign any extra docs.

payrollops: Create ticket OC-176382-02. Off-cycle run scheduled 2026-04-08 if all docs in by 2026-04-05. Need gross delta calc: monthly delta = (115000-92000)/12 = 1916.67. Confirm employee ID and whether to withhold per standard taxes.

lucy-peopleops: One more note: For cross-org chargebacks, include both originating and receiving cost center in the ticket so Finance can allocate.

ryan-recruiting: Added cost centers: from SP-2211 to DP-5590 in the ticket.

benefits-team: We'll triage carrier approval; please attach EO form.

dina-ops: Done. Ticket created and attachments uploaded. Thanks everyone :pray:
